variables.description: Stores the type of resource absence that caused the overlap. If the overlap was caused by a service appointment, this field is empty.
variables.name: absenceType

variables.description: Stores the end date and time of the day that the overlap occurs.
variables.name: end

variables.description: Stores the ID of the object that caused the overlap that’s passed into the flow.
variables.name: objectId

variables.description: Stores the type of object that triggered the overlap.
variables.name: objectType

variables.description: Stores the total length of the overlap in minutes.
variables.name: overlapLengthMinutes

variables.description: Stores the ID of the service resource that has the overlap that’s passed into the flow.
variables.name: serviceResourceId

variables.description: Stores the timezone of the service resource that has the overlap.
variables.name: serviceResourceTimezone

variables.description: Stores the ID of the service territory where the overlapping events occurred.
variables.name: serviceTerritoryId

variables.description: Stores the start date and time of the day that the overlap occurs.
variables.name: start

variables.description: Stores the status category of the service appointment that caused the overlap. If the overlap was caused by a resource absence, this field is empty.
variables.name: statusCategory

variables.description: Stores the comments added to the service appointment. If the overlap was caused by a resource absence, this field is empty.
variables.name: subject

variables.description: Stores the ID of the user that initiated the overlap and its corresponding fields that are passed into the flow.
variables.name: userId

variables.description: Stores the ID of the service appointment's work type that caused the overlap. If the overlap was caused by a resource absence, this field is empty.
variables.name: workTypeId
